PowerShell(Get-ChildItem "app\\\(marketing\)" -Name; foreach \($d in Get-ChildItem "app\\\(marketing\)"\) { git mv "app/\(marketing\)/$\($d.Name\)" "app/$\($d.Name\)" 2>&1 }; if \(Test-Path "app\\\(marketing\)"\) { Get-ChildItem "app\\\(marketing\)" -Recurse -Name; Remove-Item "app\\\(marketing\)" -Recurse }; Get-ChildItem app -Name)

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem out -Directory -Name; "---size MB"; [math]::Round\(\(\(Get-ChildItem out -Recurse -File | Measure-Object Length -Sum\).Sum / 1MB\), 1\); foreach \($d in "cache","server","types","static"\) { if \(Test-Path "out\\$d"\) { "$d : " + [math]::Round\(\(\(Get-ChildItem "out\\$d" -Recurse -File | Measure-Object Length -Sum\).Sum / 1MB\), 1\) + " MB" } })

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem out -Directory | ForEach-Object { "{0,-14} {1,8} MB" -f $_.Name, [math]::Round\(\(\(Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -File | Measure-Object Length -Sum\).Sum / 1MB\), 1\) }; "---_next"; Get-ChildItem out\\_next -Directory | ForEach-Object { "{0,-14} {1,8} MB" -f $_.Name, [math]::Round\(\(\(Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -File | Measure-Object Length -Sum\).Sum / 1MB\), 1\) }; "---dev"; Get-ChildItem out\\dev -Name | Select-Object -First 10)
